studio.title: Studio
studio.dogIntro: Name your working collie and select coat markings and coloration. Changes preview live in 3D.
studio.flockIntro: Choose the natural breed makeup of your flock. Breeds feature distinct wool and face markings.
coat.classic.name: Classic Black & White
coat.classic.description: Traditional working Border Collie with charcoal-black coat and white trim.
coat.red.name: Red & White (Sable)
coat.red.description: Warm russet-amber working collie with bright chestnut tones.
coat.merle.name: Blue Merle
coat.merle.description: Slate grey and cool charcoal mottle with crisp white markings.
coat.chocolate.name: Chocolate / Liver
coat.chocolate.description: Deep cocoa and dark chocolate coat with warm undertones.
coat.golden.name: Golden Wheaten
coat.golden.description: Honeyed pasture-gold coat with soft cream markings.
variety.heritage.name: Natural Heritage Mix
variety.heritage.description: A realistic pastoral flock with Suffolk, Cheviot, Herdwick, Kerry Hill, Badger Face, Moorit, Balwen, Jacob, and Black Welsh.
variety.classic.name: Classic Country
variety.classic.description: The traditional uniform look: all cream sheep with charcoal-black heads.
variety.highland.name: Upland Fells
variety.highland.description: Hardy hill and moorland breeds: steel Herdwick, cinnamon Moorit, and Black Welsh.
variety.marked.name: Marked & Badger Breeds
variety.marked.description: Striking patterns: Kerry Hill panda markings, Badger Face stripes, Balwen blazes, and Jacob piebalds.
variety.black.name: Black Welsh Mountain
variety.black.description: A striking flock of all-dark sheep with deep espresso wool.
breed.suffolk.name: Suffolk Down
breed.suffolk.description: The traditional countryside icon: dense warm cream fleece with jet charcoal head and shanks.
breed.cheviot.name: Cheviot White-faced
breed.cheviot.description: Hardy hill sheep with a bright white fleece and distinctive pale white-faced head without black markings.
breed.herdwick.name: Herdwick
breed.herdwick.description: Legendary fell breed famous for its rugged steel blue-grey fleece and hoar-frosted white head and legs.
breed.kerry_hill.name: Kerry Hill
breed.kerry_hill.description: Famous British border breed with dense white wool and striking panda-like black patches on the eyes, nose, and knees.
breed.badger_face.name: Badger Face Welsh Mountain
breed.badger_face.description: Ancient Celtic breed (Torddu) featuring warm oatmeal fleece, distinctive black badger eye stripes, and dark throat.
breed.moorit.name: Moorit Shetland
breed.moorit.description: Heritage moorland breed naturally colored in rich cinnamon and chocolate-brown fleece and matching brown face.
breed.balwen.name: Balwen Welsh Mountain
breed.balwen.description: Distinctive Welsh hill sheep with deep peat-charcoal fleece, a crisp white facial blaze, and white socks.
breed.jacob.name: Jacob
breed.jacob.description: Ancient British heritage breed featuring warm toasted wheat wool with deep charcoal-brown points.
breed.black.name: Black Welsh Mountain
breed.black.description: Ancient British heritage breed featuring completely dark, lustrous espresso-charcoal fleece and deep dark points.
